split_policy.anchor_objects: select frequent object instances while covering as many categories as possible
split_policy.train: scene contains at least one anchor object instance with >= 4 views
split_policy.test1: held-out scene contains at least one anchor object instance with >= 4 views
split_policy.test2: scene contains at least one non-anchor object whose category is an anchor category and has >= 4 views
split_policy.test3: random from remaining scenes after train/test1/test2
